info.title: cp-core API
info.description: Cleverphotos core API for cp-web. Session cookie + X-CSRFToken. See docs/api.md.

get.description: Sets the csrftoken cookie. Call once on app start; send its value as X-CSRFToken.

post.description:
Sends a sign-in code (dev: to the server log and the admin). `role` defaults to participant.

Errors: 404 event_not_found · 422 invalid_phone_number, invalid_role, validation_error ·
429 rate_limit_exceeded (3 codes per phone per 15 min; 30 s between codes).

Checks the code; signs in, or creates the account. Sets the session cookie. Follow `nextStep`.

Errors: 410 otp_expired · 422 invalid_otp, validation_error · 429 rate_limit_exceeded (5 wrong codes).

get.description: The signed-in user. 401 authentication_required when signed out (use on app start).

patch.description:
Profile: fullName (required), email (optional, null clears).

Errors: 403 csrf_failed · 409 email_already_in_use · 422 validation_error.

post.description:
KVKK explicit consent to the version the screen showed (`user.kvkk.version`); logged with
version, language, file hash, IP and browser.

Errors: 403 csrf_failed · 409 consent_version_outdated (re-fetch /api/me, show the new text) ·
422 explicit_consent_required (granted false), validation_error.

get.description: Events the user has opened, newest activity first.
The user's selfies (slots primary, secondary). Poll after an upload until status leaves processing.

post.description:
multipart/form-data: file (JPEG/PNG/WebP/HEIC, ≤ 50 MB), slot. Replaces the slot's selfie.
Processing is asynchronous: poll GET /api/me/selfies.

Errors: 403 consent_required, csrf_failed · 422 unsupported_file_type, unreadable_image,
file_too_large, invalid_slot, validation_error.

delete.description: Deletes the selfie and its face data. Errors: 404 selfie_not_found.

get.description:
A KVKK document PDF, current or older (what earlier consents refer to). Public.
The current files: `user.kvkk.urls`. Errors: 404 not_found.

head.description:
A KVKK document PDF, current or older (what earlier consents refer to). Public.
The current files: `user.kvkk.urls`. Errors: 404 not_found.

get.description:
The welcome screen: no photos, no counts. With a session, also adds the event to the user's events.

Errors: 404 event_not_found · 410 event_expired · 423 event_access_closed ·
429 rate_limit_exceeded (30 per minute per IP).

Photos of me (`view=mine`, face matching) or all photos (`view=all`, when canBrowseAll).
Ordered by capture time; `cursor` is an offset, `limit` ≤ 500. Always current: re-fetch to see new matches.

Errors: 404 event_not_found · 410 event_expired · 423 event_access_closed · 403 consent_required, browse_all_not_allowed · 422 validation_error (bad view).

One photo with previous/next in the same view, and downloads left today.

Errors: 404 event_not_found · 410 event_expired · 423 event_access_closed · 403 consent_required, browse_all_not_allowed · 404 photo_not_found (not in this view).
Errors: 404 photo_not_found · 429 download_limit_reached (3 per photo per 24 h).

Balance, totals, events that are not expired (newest first).

Errors: 403 organizer_access_required.

My events, newest first; expired ones only with `includeExpired=true`.

Errors: 403 organizer_access_required.

post.description:
multipart/form-data: name, type, date (YYYY-MM-DD), city, venue (optional), hasFaceSearch,
allowsBrowseAll, requiresConsent (optional, defaults true/false/true), cover (optional image).
The event is open at once; the code is generated. Creating costs nothing.

Errors: 403 organizer_access_required · 422 validation_error, invalid_event_settings,
unsupported_file_type, unreadable_image, file_too_large (cover).

get.description:
One event with counts, settings and the join link.

Errors: 403 organizer_access_required · 404 event_not_found.

patch.description:
Change any of: name, type, date, city, venue, settings, and `status` (`active` = open,
`access_closed` = participants locked out). Omitted fields stay.

Errors: 403 organizer_access_required · 404 event_not_found · 410 event_expired ·
422 validation_error, invalid_event_settings.

post.description:
multipart/form-data: file (image). Free; replaces the previous uploaded cover.

Errors: 404 event_not_found · 410 event_expired · 422 unsupported_file_type, unreadable_image, file_too_large.

delete.description: Removes the uploaded cover; the first photo is shown instead. Errors: 404 event_not_found.

200.description: Cover ~400 px (uploaded cover, else the first photo)

post.description:
Before an upload: does the balance cover `photoCount` photos? Not enough is not an error
(`eligible: false`, `missingCredits`). The upload itself checks every photo again.

Errors: 404 event_not_found · 410 event_expired.

multipart/form-data: repeated `files` (max 20 per request, ≤ 50 MB each, whole request ≤ 60 MB)
and optionally the same number of `clientIds`, echoed back in `results`. Each file is accepted or
rejected on its own; 1 credit per accepted photo. Per-file `errorCode`: unsupported_file_type,
unreadable_image, file_too_large, duplicate_photo, insufficient_credits.

Errors: 404 event_not_found · 410 event_expired · 422 too_many_files, validation_error.

get.description:
All photos of the event in upload order; `status` filter: queued, processing, ready, failed.
`cursor` is an offset, `limit` ≤ 500.

Errors: 404 event_not_found · 422 validation_error (bad status).

delete.description:
JSON body {"photoIds": ["00017", ...]}: deletes those photos (files and faces at once).
Credits are not refunded. Unknown ids are skipped (`affectedCount` tells how many went).

Errors: 404 event_not_found.

get.description:
People who opened the event (most recently active first): name, masked phone, where they
are in consent → selfie → matching, and how many photos they appear in. No phone numbers,
selfies or face data.

Errors: 404 event_not_found.

The products on sale (managed in the admin), the balance and the price version to buy with.

Errors: 403 organizer_access_required.

This account's purchases, newest first (max 100).

Errors: 403 organizer_access_required.

post.description:
Buy one product: checks it is on sale and the price version, takes the payment, adds the
credits. Development servers simulate the payment: it always succeeds at once. With the real
payment provider (iyzico, not connected yet) this step will hand back a payment page instead;
the credits then arrive after the payment.

Errors: 403 organizer_access_required · 404 not_found (product not on sale) ·
409 pricing_changed (reload the products) · 501 payment_not_available.
